QuestInfo.0:
There's no better time for Bingo than in the middle of a dreary winter! Check the Bingo board every day and receive some awesome prizes when you've filled up the entire Bingo board! Try making it to the game every day!

0.0: We're already in the middle of winter. Time flies, doesn't it? Feels like there should be an event to cheer up this dreary time of year. I know! How about Winter Bingo? Find 20 Bingo Necklaces from monsters, and I'll put a stamp on your Bingo Board.

yes.0: The event will start now! You must bring me 20 Bingo Necklaces!\n\n#i4032420# 20 #t4032420#s

no.0: You know, if you fill up your Bingo Board, you'll get a treasure chest full of items. Are you sure you're not interested?
